text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! To tend to the fields without fail 
even amidst such busy days is truly 
admirable!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Neither vegetables nor races are grown in 
a day! Daily effort is sure to bear 
wonderful fruit!
